news.title: Nation Sim
news.summary: We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game, Nation Sim! Dive into a world of strategy and diplomacy as you build and manage your own nation.
highlights: Build and manage your own nation in a deep simulation sandbox.
news.status: The game is out now on itch.io.

news.title: Castle Wars Update 1.2
news.summary: Get ready for our biggest update yet! Castle Wars 1.2 brings new levels and a completely revamped combat system.
highlights: 5 New Levels: Explore new castles and battlefields.
Revamped AI System: Experience more dynamic and strategic battles.
news.status: The update is scheduled for release on November 1st!
